description:
*Welcome to your new home at 2/9 Charles Street, Maylands! This delightful brick house offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience, making it an ideal choice for families or professionals seeking a peaceful yet vibrant neighborhood.

**Property Features:**- **Bedrooms:** 3 spacious bedrooms, each designed with comfort in mind, providing ample natural light and cozy living spaces.- **Bathrooms:** 1 well-appointed bathroom featuring modern fixtures and a clean, inviting design.- **Carport:** 1 dedicated carport space for your convenience, ensuring easy access to your home.**Interior Highlights:**Step inside to discover a beautifully designed interior that combines functionality with modern aesthetics. The open-plan living area is perfect for entertaining or relaxing with family, featuring stylish flooring and a warm ambiance. **Outdoor Oasis:**Enjoy the best of both worlds with a lovely outdoor space that includes a well-maintained garden, lush grass, and mature trees providing shade and tranquility. Whether you're hosting a weekend BBQ or enjoying a quiet evening under the stars, this outdoor area is sure to impress.

**Location:**Located in the heart of Maylands, this property is just a stone's throw away from local parks, cafes, and shops. With easy access to public transport, commuting to the city or surrounding areas is a breeze.**Additional Features:**- Charming handrails and railings enhancing safety and style- Beautifully landscaped garden with a variety of plants and trees- A serene environment that connects you with nature. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to lease a beautiful home in a sought-after location. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and make 2/9 Charles Street your new address! For inquiries or to schedule a viewing, please contact us at [insert contact information]. We look forward to welcoming you to your new home!


HOW TO INSPECT THIS PROPERTY
Arranging inspections is easy!

Simply click on the button above marked 'Book an Inspection Time' and then enter your personal details to choose from them offered pre-arranged viewing opportunities.
Only after first registering can you then be able to INSTANTLY secure your access to updates, changes or cancellations for any appointments for the property.

Only registered applicants can view the property. Applicants who have not first registered may miss any opportunity to view the property.

Note, there is a current very high demand for rental properties here in WA.
So, to ensure you have a place DON'T MISS OUT and register to book for a viewing appointment today!

When you submit your place application please check all your details are current and accurate to ensure swift consideration and approval.

NOTE ALL APPLICATIONS:
- Applicants are invited to apply for the property as soon as possible.
- Applications will not be sent to the owner for approval unless you have first VIEWED the property. Please make sure you have registered to view; you will then receive a text letting you know the time and date.
- Applications will not be processed unless full ACCURATE & COMPLETE details are provided in the application including supporting documents.
Please do not email a request to view - all requests are to be made via the link to register.

*Important*
Whilst every care is taken in the preparation of the information contained in this marketing, Rental Management Australia will not be held liable for any errors in typing or information. All information is considered correct at the time of printing. Potential Tenants should complete their own due diligence, including a visual inspection before entering into an offer to lease and should not rely on the photos or text in this advertisement.
